summary: Implemented `group --price <plan>` (U7/C3/R6): a sub-second, zero-codegraph, zero-graph-build pricing mode. Added `parse_task_map_for_pricing` to plan_reader.py (filesystem-only task-map parse, no CodegraphClient, symbols skipped since pricing never reads them), and `TaskPrice`/`SlicePrice`/`PriceReport`/`price_task_mappings`/`price_plan` to estimator.py, reusing the existing `node_work`/`partition_budget_cap` formulas and compiling base context with an empty codegraph summary per the plan's approximation decision. Wired `--price` into cli.py's `group` subcommand, dispatched before any codegraph/LLM/usage-limit machinery, printing per-task and per-slice node-work/coder-work figures against the approximate cap and exiting non-zero on overshoot. Wrote tests/test_cli_price.py covering the over-cap exit path, the never-touches-codegraph guarantee (via a raising client-runner stub), a missing-task-map error path, and a cross-check against this repo's real 2026-08-26 plan document (copied into an isolated tmp repo to avoid touching the real worktree's .orchestrator/) proving --price's per-task node work matches grouping-trace.json's node_work from a real `group --no-spec` run on the same map, sub-second. Full suite: 1477 passed; 5 pre-existing failures are unrelated sandbox/filesystem environment issues (confinement policy dir permissions, cross-device git worktree move), not touched by this change.
